full_prompt_en: A square, vividly colored painterly portrait shows a young woman from the shoulders up, resting her chin on one hand against a deep blue and teal background. Her head fills the center, tilted slightly to the right, while large green-blue eyes look upward toward the upper right. Thick violet and plum hair sweeps across her forehead and gathers in a loose knot toward the upper left, with stray curved strands framing her cheek. Warm orange and magenta light runs through the hair and across the top of her forehead, contrasting with the cooler shadow at the side of her face. Her pale skin is modeled with cream, peach, lilac, and soft rose strokes; a small warm highlight sits on the nose and the pink lips remain gently parted. The hand rises from the lower right, fingers curled beneath the chin, and the wrist disappears into the dark sleeve. A blue-black garment forms a broad low shape across the bottom, with only a slim warm yellow area near the neck. Behind her, turquoise swirls, navy pockets, and scattered tiny yellow, pink, and blue specks suggest a densely painted, almost starry field rather than a specific place. The face has smooth gradual transitions, but visible colored marks remain in the hair, sleeve, and background. Delicate dark lines define eyelashes and the upper eye shapes without turning the whole image into a hard outline drawing. Light arrives from the upper left and front, brightening the eye whites, upper cheek, forehead, and fingertips, while violet-blue shade deepens along the far jaw and clothing. The overall composition makes the searching upward gaze the focal point, held by saturated jewel colors and lively, layered paint texture.
full_prompt_zh: 这幅方形、色彩鲜明的绘画式肖像描绘一位年轻女子的肩部以上形象。她在深蓝与青绿色背景前用一只手托住下巴。头部占据中央，略向右倾，大而绿蓝的眼睛望向右上方。浓密的紫色与梅紫头发扫过额头，在左上方松松盘起，弯曲的散发沿面颊垂下。暖橙与洋红色光穿过头发、掠过额头上部，与脸侧较冷的阴影对照。浅色皮肤由奶油、桃色、淡紫和浅玫瑰笔触塑形；鼻上有一点暖色高光，粉色嘴唇微微分开。手从右下方升起，手指弯在下巴下，手腕消失在深色袖口中。蓝黑衣服在底部形成宽阔低矮的形状，颈旁仅露出一条暖黄色区域。她身后，青绿旋涡、藏蓝色块和散落的细小黄、粉、蓝点暗示一片浓密绘制、近乎星空的色域，而非具体地点。面庞有平滑渐变，头发、袖子和背景仍留有可见彩色笔迹。纤细深线勾出睫毛与上眼形，却没有把整幅图变成硬轮廓线稿。光从左上及前方到来，提亮眼白、上脸颊、额头和指尖，紫蓝色阴影则沿远侧下颌与衣物加深。整体构图以向上探寻的目光为焦点，由浓郁宝石色与活跃的层叠颜料肌理托住。
style_prompt_en: The image has a saturated painterly finish with smooth tonal modeling inside focal shapes and energetic colored strokes around them. Deep cobalt, teal, violet, and plum form a dense cool field, cut by small warm orange, magenta, and gold accents. Contours are selectively crisp at expressive details but break into swirls, short marks, and fine speckles toward the outer areas. Illumination is warm from the upper front, creating luminous pale planes against cool blue-violet recesses; highlights are compact rather than uniformly glossy. Layered color gives the dark areas internal movement instead of reducing them to flat black. The overall effect is intimate and dreamlike, with a quiet central form suspended within a vivid, sparkling surround.
style_prompt_zh: 图像具有高饱和的绘画完成面，焦点形体内部调性塑造平滑，周围则是活跃的彩色笔触。深钴蓝、青绿、紫与梅紫构成浓密冷色域，被少量暖橙、洋红和金色切开。轮廓在富表现力的细节处有选择地清晰，向外围则破碎为旋转线、短笔和细小斑点。暖光从前上方照来，使浅色平面在冷蓝紫凹处前发亮；高光紧凑而非通体光滑。层叠色彩让暗部内部保持运动，不沦为平黑。整体效果亲密而如梦，安静中央形体悬在鲜艳闪烁的环境中。
theme_en: A young woman with violet hair resting her chin on her hand
theme_zh: 一位紫发年轻女子托腮凝望
name: Tanya Shatseva
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
